# SEO Inspector — Privacy Policy

**Effective date:** August 18, 2026

This policy covers the SEO Inspector browser extension for Chrome and Microsoft Edge, published by N5KWD. It does not apply to other pages or services on this website.

## Summary

SEO Inspector does not collect, transmit, sell, or share any personal data. Everything the extension does happens on your own device.

## What SEO Inspector does

When you open the extension on a web page, it reads that page's SEO-related elements — the title, meta tags, headings, images, links, and structured data — and shows you a report. The page is analyzed in place, inside your browser. No page content, browsing activity, or personal information is ever sent to us or to anyone else. The extension makes no network requests to any server we operate, contains no analytics or telemetry, and has no third-party integrations.

## What is stored on your device

The extension keeps a small amount of data in your browser's extension storage:

- **Preferences** — whether you use the popup or sidebar view, and which report sections you have collapsed. These are stored with your browser's extension sync storage, so your own browser may sync them across devices where you are signed in with the same profile. We never see them.
- **Analysis history** — for your convenience, the extension remembers the URL, score, check counts, and timestamp of your recent analyses (up to 200 entries). This history is stored only on your device, is never transmitted anywhere, and can be erased at any time with the **Clear** button in the extension's history view.

Uninstalling the extension removes all of this data.

## Permissions the extension requests

- **Read data on websites you visit** — required so the extension can read a page's SEO elements to build its report, and so the sidebar view can re-analyze pages automatically as you browse. The extension only reads pages to generate the report you see; it does not modify pages or capture their content for any other purpose.
- **Storage** — saves the preferences and local history described above.
- **Side panel** — enables the sidebar view.

## Children's privacy

SEO Inspector does not collect data from anyone, including children.

## Changes to this policy

If a future version of the extension changes what data is handled, this policy will be updated here before that version is released, with a new effective date.

## Contact

Questions about this policy or the extension can be sent through the project's issue tracker at https://github.com/HHRSDev/seo-inspector/issues.
